reviews.text: Sent over from Assistance Aux Animaux who explained that they negotiated their patients a lower price. Maybe true but when you get there you are quoted the normal price officially written on the window and also on official websites. They only care about money and this place is a scam. They already overcharged me more than once, to make up for their exorbitant prices to the foundation clients who normally walked a kilometre to get there from republic clinic tell us we can make payments on their payment plan. They do not honor the comittment made with Fondation Assoc aux Animaux and using the scam to get new clients at the regular prices. If you are already going to foundation you have proved with your documents that you dont have to funds to pay a normal clinic. And then you get drug over to this clinic with a promise and then just get scammed. Not nice people. Looking for your money by hook or crook. Found cheaper services on a quick search on google paris 1 rue Étienne Marcel.

Good evening everyone, I brought my cat in because she was bleeding initially. They told me she needed hydration and food, but after two days she refused to eat. I was told everything was fine, that she wasn't bleeding anymore, but that we needed to schedule a biopsy in seven days as the equipment wasn't up to scratch. They said I could pick her up at 6 PM. However, at 5:45 PM, they told us she was dying, that she had lost blood in her stool, which was very unclear because they had never mentioned it before. I had to have her euthanized. I absolutely do not recommend this lack of professionalism. The video of the supposed hydration IV was full of blood, and the machine was malfunctioning…

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic and its staff; you can go there without hesitation. The team is exceptional, from the veterinarians to the veterinary assistants! They are incredibly gentle and patient, and you can tell that the animal's well-being is their top priority.

We brought our cat in after suspecting she had ingested a foreign object. The entire team was extraordinary, both during the surgery and the care they provided to Utopie, and with us, keeping us updated, reassuring us, and supporting us throughout the process. A huge thank you from Utopie and her parents!

Dr. David Bourdais-Massenet is lovely and very professional. I have complete confidence in him.

It's a real pleasure to be able to talk with this veterinarian. He takes excellent care of my dog, Buffy. And as an added bonus, he has a great sense of humor!

He manages to put both the owner and the dog at ease!

Well done and thank you so much.

P.S.: The reception is top-notch too!!!!

Avoid this clinic for senior dog care

(Clinic acquired by an industrial group)

A loyal client of this clinic for years, back when Dr. Kupfer was there, I no longer recognize the team or the quality of care.

The clinic has been taken over by the AniCura group, and the approach to medicine has become purely industrial and commercial.

My senior dog was put on a commercial prescription diet, whereas she had always been fed a homemade diet.
In just six weeks, this food caused catastrophic side effects: massive weight gain, extreme thirst, severe constipation, major skin allergies, and a painful lameness that resurfaced due to the strain on her joints.
Faced with this distress, the young veterinarian I saw that day displayed a complete lack of empathy and understanding. Worse still, the team contradicted themselves: the first vet scheduled a urine test for me at the end of August to stop this intensive treatment, while today's vet was directive and insisted on imposing this commercial diet for life, without considering that it was making my dog ​​sick. No comprehensive or home-based alternatives were offered, other than an expensive injection with no guarantee of success and a completely unrealistic referral to a specialist in Maisons-Alfort.
I wanted advice for the comfort and well-being of my aging pet, and I received none!
They're trying to force animals into commercial categories and standardized protocols dictated by partner brands, at the expense of common sense and the well-being of older dogs.
I paid over 80 euros to leave without any solutions. I'll go elsewhere from now on.

Avoid at all costs! This was the first time in my life I'd ever gone to a vet other than my usual one, and unfortunately, this first experience was very disappointing. I only came to this clinic because it was an emergency and my cat had just been in an accident.

I had an appointment at 2:00 AM and arrived at 1:53 AM. Upon arrival, the reception was very cold. I wasn't asked any questions about my cat's condition or what had happened, despite his meows.

A woman then arrived with her dog. I noticed that the receptionist took the time to attend to her dog and saw him before my cat. After waiting for about 50 minutes, I simply asked calmly why I had been given an appointment at 2:00 AM if I was going to have to wait so long.

I was told that the dog was considered more urgent because he hadn't urinated. I can perfectly understand that a veterinary emergency takes priority; that's absolutely not what I'm complaining about.

What deeply shocked me was the difference in attitude I felt towards me compared to other clients. When I simply asked my question, I was met with a very haughty response that if I wasn't happy, I should just leave.

I can't say for sure why I was treated this way, but I clearly felt a difference in treatment, and this attitude made me particularly uncomfortable.

In an emergency, when you're already very worried about your pet, you expect at the very least to be listened to, respected, and shown a little empathy.

It's really a shame, because I simply came seeking help for my cat.

I do not recommend them.

My boyfriend and I arrived at the emergency vet clinic at 4:00 AM because our cat was seriously ill and in a very worrying condition. He wasn't eating, had absolutely no strength left, and was collapsing.

Upon arrival, we were charged €120 for a diagnosis that wasn't even performed, and told to expect about an hour's wait. Then, without even properly examining our cat, we were told he would need surgery, at a cost of €1,500.

We were finally advised to wait until the daytime clinic opened, with the assurance that he wasn't in a condition to die and that we could go home.

Just three hours after we got home, our cat sadly passed away.

We are deeply shocked and devastated. We weren't even given the chance to find out what was really wrong with him, or what had happened to him. We came seeking urgent help to save our companion, and we left certain he could wait a few hours… only to find he died shortly afterward.

An extremely painful and difficult situation to accept.

Do not go there for an emergency.
Very satisfied with the follow-up and diagnosis of my cat; very competent and gentle
Very good clinic

The vets are lovely and very professional. I've been coming for years with my dog ​​and recently with my cats, and everything always goes perfectly. They are gentle, reassuring, and truly passionate. I recommend them 100%!
Wonderful specialists who love their work. They take excellent care of animals and saved our dog. They called us regularly to update us on our dog's health.

In response to the clinic's reply:

It seems that even with so much space, we were shown into a room with only one chair, as there were two of us. This forced one of us to sit on the floor in the middle of the night, right in front of your two staff members who came by 6 or 7 times... It would seem that this is definitely the right place. It would also seem that you have a lot of work to do regarding customer service and taking feedback into account.

We hope this negative experience will prompt you to give your team a little reminder; it's clearly necessary!

Sincerely.

--------------------------------------

Clearly a money-making machine. We came with our pet, had three ultrasounds, including one from a specialist, and found nothing, while another veterinary clinic found the problem on the first try for much less money... I won't even mention having to wait around in a cramped room, sitting on the floor, without any of the emergency vets even considering bringing in a chair. A place to avoid.

Our little Zoé was really unwell. The vet gave us a wonderful welcome, reassured us, and explained her serious problem. Despite the situation, he found the right words to calm our worries. We highly recommend this clinic.
The vet had excellent contact with the animal, a very good diagnosis, and was very available.
I recommend them; they were very attentive and professional for my first appointment.

A huge thank you to the entire team for the warm welcome extended to my two female cats during their spaying. Everything went perfectly, from the initial consultation to the post-operative advice.

The team is passionate, extremely gentle with animals, and always available to reassure owners.

I strongly advise against this veterinary clinic, which treated my rabbit very poorly over a year ago. His pododermatitis was misdiagnosed, and when I took him there for an emergency, they refused to see him again. He died that same evening in agony, and they had the nerve to ask me via WhatsApp message what had happened and if I wanted to explain his death. Pathetic!
Reputable veterinary clinic

Hello! Owning a dog is brand new to me, and thank God I'm especially happy to be able to travel with my little guy. Thank you, and see you soon!
Happy December and happy holidays! ✋️🙏🏾🙏💙👋 …

I took my dog for pre-departure health check and vaccinations, Dr. Bourdais-Massenet was well-informed of the procedures and documentation required for entry into Singapore, and was thorough and gentle with my dog. I was assured that we were in good hands.
Very pleasant and professional team, high-quality care
As a customer for years, I can say the team is reliable, friendly, and competent.
Just an incredible encounter
I am delighted by the welcome I received, the kindness, professionalism and honesty of this team.
The staff were very attentive, reassuring and professional.
A competent veterinarian who listens to our pet and its owner. They don't try to perform expensive treatments at all costs with a lot of unnecessary tests. Very professional.

Thank you to them for their kindness on Sunday, May 31st. I brought my dog's body. They took care of everything immediately.

They are great.

The clinic supported me through the final moments of my cat's life with great care, patience, and empathy. He was hospitalized there in excellent conditions; I was able to visit him quite easily, and they were very flexible. They were also very empathetic and clear about the end-of-life process.

A huge thank you to Dr. David Bourdais-Massenet and the entire team at Clinique AniCura Paris III for their warm welcome, professionalism, and kindness.

My cat Simba was treated with great gentleness and care. Dr. Bourdais-Massenet was particularly attentive, reassuring, and incredibly kind, both to Simba and to me.

During these worrying times, it's invaluable to be able to rely on such a competent and compassionate team. Simba is doing much better now, and I am so grateful.

I recommend this clinic without hesitation to all pet owners.

Thank you again to the whole team for the excellent care given to my little Simba. 🐾❤️

— Alexandra Ouzeau and Simba 🐱💕

Hello,

⭐️I came to the AniCura Veterinary Clinic in Paris III, on the advice of Dr. Lebbat, to have our little darling dog x-rayed, and I want to thank the entire team for their warm welcome and professionalism.

⭐️From the very first call, the woman on the phone was extremely kind, patient, and very clear in her explanations regarding the prices, the procedures, and even directions to the clinic. Despite our fatigue after a long day, it was very reassuring to have the x-ray done there.

⭐️Once there, the whole team was smiling, caring, and professional.

⭐️The people who performed the x-ray were incredibly gentle, patient, and reassuring with our little darling, who was quite scared. They took the time to explain everything calmly.

We also received the images quickly by email, which was much appreciated.

⭐️A huge thank you to Dr. Lebbat for his professionalism and for referring us to such a reputable and caring clinic.

We returned home reassured and with a smile.

I wholeheartedly recommend Clinique Vétérinaire AniCura Paris ❤️ A very clean and well-organized clinic.

Best regards

I haven’t been to other vets in Paris but I was lucky to get to this one from the start. Was recommended to go to this clinic by a woman at the grocery store when I complained about my dogs digestion. Problem resolved, but I still visit when I need.

Whether it's the emergency room or the daytime staff, you can go there with complete confidence.

They take the time to answer questions and address concerns; they are professional yet compassionate.
I take Caline there knowing she'll be well cared for 🙏
Thank you for her!
A top-notch clinic, especially from a point of view

We've been taking our dog Ariane to them since she was a puppy, and we couldn't be happier. Even before she arrived, we were able to ask questions—a rare level of availability that immediately inspires confidence.

We're seen by Dr. Clerc, but the entire team deserves a special mention: welcoming, reassuring, and always offering sound advice. For us, as first-time dog owners, this caring environment has been invaluable, especially during puppyhood.

Even today, the team remains very accessible—whether by phone, by visiting the clinic directly, or in case of an emergency. We're so glad that Ariane receives ongoing care here. A truly trustworthy clinic, without a doubt! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Highly professional and empathetic with animals and their owners

I really liked this clinic. The staff is wonderful, very attentive and kind; you immediately feel at ease! We went there for a routine check-up and then to the emergency room, and they helped us a lot. I think we were really lucky in choosing this clinic (we had already tried three others!!), from now on we will only go there.
Excellent practice. Great reception, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up. It's fantastic that it's next to the Emergency Department.
I just left the clinic after my cat was poisoned... the staff were attentive, very competent, and kind... I highly recommend them. A big thank you!
They got my cat back on his feet, I can't thank them enough. They're a perfect team: caring, kind, professional, and patient. You couldn't ask for anything better! Bravo! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 …

The kindest people are working in this clinic. Helped us with tapeworm treatment for onward travel and also treated our dog for his stomach upset. I love that they didnt rush to give him antibiotics but rather some supplements that helped clear up his issue in a couple of days. Very professional and helpful.

Loky was very ill, but we received all the answers to our questions and were able to be with him until the end, staying as long as we wished.
Thank you again during this difficult time.
Outrageous! They're asking me to drop off my cat at 8:30 am. No one is there.
A fantastic and welcoming team, thank you!!!
Definitely still very good
i’ve been both to the urgent care and the day time clinics, and i would recommend both if you’re looking for good care in the neighborhood

I highly recommend Dr. Clerc for her kindness and patience. She's wonderful with animals, and my very timid little cat lets Dr. Clerc approach and pet her because her approach is gentle and reassuring! Thank you for your care! ✨
I was seen at 7 pm, just as the clinic was closing, by his regular vet who stayed for 25 minutes to explain the dog's condition. I am very happy and highly recommend this clinic.

I would like to sincerely thank the veterinary clinic for the excellent welcome we received on January 27th. I came with my little dog, Lola, and we were seen very quickly, with great kindness and care.

Despite Lola being stressed, not very friendly, and trying to bite, the entire team showed patience, understanding, and love towards her. The veterinarian treated her wound with great professionalism, carefully disinfected it, and explained in detail everything I needed to do afterward.

He also answered all my questions clearly and reassuringly. I am truly happy to have found a clinic where we are welcomed with such warmth and where our animals receive prompt help.

A huge thank you for your compassion, professionalism, and prompt assistance to my dog. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. 🐾

We had been searching for a veterinarian who met our expectations for a long time, and we found him at AniCura. The veterinarian who saw our Freddie was calm, patient, gentle, and thorough in her analysis to understand what was wrong with our dog, while also offering us solutions. She also assured us of her availability for the follow-up care of our pet.
A huge thank you to your entire team!

This clinic is highly professional. I've been taking my cat there for three years now, and the advice is always very honest (unlike some other clinics that try to upsell you), the welcome is always very warm, and you feel comfortable and confident. Sure, the patient isn't always thrilled about going, but at least they're healthy.

I arrived with my eleven-year-old cat, who was vomiting for reasons I couldn't understand. A consultation with Dr. Aude Desmyter and a thorough abdominal ultrasound helped us understand what was happening and led to a change in diet. Hypersensitive Courtaud was very relaxed and even cooperative during the consultation and examinations, so evident was the empathy of the veterinarian and the ultrasound technician towards him. I left relieved and happy to have found this practice for my cat.
I should mention that I am a 74-year-old woman, and Courtaud is not my first cat.
I highly recommend this practice.

Sincerely, Jeanne Lacroix
Responsive and attentive team.

A huge thank you to this incredible team! First and foremost, thank you to Dr. Bourdais for his professionalism and hard work, which saved my 6-month-old puppy. She had parvovirus, and we almost lost her. Thanks to the whole team—Lou, Laura, Jennifer, Amandine, and Adeline—I also have to mention Clara! We were able to see her every day, including December 31st and January 1st. I truly can't thank them enough for what they did. They saved my dog ​​from certain death if she hadn't received timely and proper care. I will forever hold the whole team in my heart, as will my husband. You saved our beloved puppy! Thank you so much!
